section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1969
title: 10 Table 5 furnishes the distribution of accidental deaths by sex in different States, Union Territories and Cities. On an Average about 2/3rd of the persons (62.8%) who were involved in accidental deaths were males. A similar pattern has been observed in almost all the States, excepting Assam, Jammu & Kashmir and Punjab, where the percentage of males involved was 77.8%, 76.2% and 82.0% respectively. Among the Union Territories also, the over-all percentage (71.2) of male casualties was higher than the All India average. Among the comparable Cities, Calcutta and Delhi recorded more than 70% of male casualties. TABLE 5
